output.summary: A user with ulcerative colitis described frequent bowel urgency with occasional blood that disrupts work and parenting, and they felt embarrassed and dismissed by a general doctor who said it was just how UC is. The bot explained that this suggests under-controlled disease, outlined treatment step-up options including rectal mesalamine, ways to speed a specialist referral, a calprotectin test, coping tips and caution about loperamide. The user ended feeling they had a plan and relief from shame.
